entries.title: OAuth state/nonce/PKCE, redirect URI, CSRF and token rotation penetration test
reviewer_actions: Run an independent penetration test against a deployed host, not the unit suite.
Attempt redirect-URI substitution, state replay and nonce reuse against the live callback.

entries.title: Negative authorisation matrix across tenant, user, account, folder, object, vector and trace
reviewer_actions: Attempt cross-tenant reads against a deployed database with the application role.
Confirm Row Level Security is forced rather than assumed.

entries.title: HTML XSS, tracking pixel, SSRF, MIME confusion and hostile attachment handling
reviewer_actions: Send hostile mail through a real provider mailbox and confirm no fetch is made by MailHub.
Review the object-store path for SSRF reachable from a provider-supplied URL.

entries.title: Secret, body and PII scanning across logs, traces, metrics, errors, analytics, backups and dead letters
reviewer_actions: Confirm the scanner covers a deployed host's log sink, which is outside this repository.

entries.title: Connection revocation, account deletion, export, TTL cleanup and deletion proof
reviewer_actions: Confirm deletion proof against a real object store, which this repository does not host.

entries.title: PIPL/GDPR, provider terms, cross-border transfer, processors and user consent review
reviewer_actions: Legal review; no repository artifact can substitute for it.

entries.title: Dependency, image, SDK, SBOM, signature, vulnerability, supply chain and licence gates
reviewer_actions: Confirm the SBOM is generated in the release pipeline rather than committed by hand.

entries.title: SLO, alerting, on-call and incident runbooks for provider outage, credential leak, mis-send, knowledge pollution and cross-tenant events
reviewer_actions: Write the runbooks against the deployed topology; this repository has no pager or on-call rota.

entries.title: Backup, restore, PITR and object lifecycle drill with measured RPO and RTO
reviewer_actions: Repeat against the production topology; object lifecycle and cross-region copies are not covered here.

entries.title: Fault injection for webhook gaps, invalid cursors, 429/5xx, DNS and network loss, worker kill, lease expiry and database failover
reviewer_actions: Extend to provider-side 429/5xx and KMS or scanner unavailability, which need real services.

entries.title: Capacity test across accounts, messages per day, long threads, large attachments, search, AI queue and provider quotas
reviewer_actions: Re-run at the intended production volume; the recorded baseline is a floor, not a capacity claim.

entries.title: Cost dashboard for provider API, object storage, parsing, OCR, model tokens, cost per thousand messages and budget blocking
reviewer_actions: Build against the deployed billing sources; no cost telemetry exists in this repository.

entries.title: Tenant, provider and global kill switches with four-eyes change control and audit
reviewer_actions: Deploy the host-side four-eyes change interface, persistent switch ledger and alerting.

entries.title: Internal test users only, controlled provider test accounts
reviewer_actions: Enable the feature flag for named internal users in the pilot product.

entries.title: Second host completes the same read and candidate end-to-end path, proving core portability
reviewer_actions: Run the conformance bundle against a second, independently built host.

entries.title: Thirty consecutive days at SLO with no data leak, double send or duplicate task
reviewer_actions: Observe a running deployment for thirty days; no local drill can produce this.

entries.title: Production security, privacy, provider verification, data residency and licence approval
reviewer_actions: Security, privacy and provider owners sign; the records belong to the adopting product.

entries.title: GA compatibility matrix, known limitations, migration and rollback, support policy and roadmap
reviewer_actions: Publish for the adopting product; the migration drill proves the kit against a labelled fixture, not a customer cutover.

entries.title: Shadow, cutover, rollback and cleanup evidence for MX, with infrastructure and business ownership stated separately
reviewer_actions: Run on the real legacy module; the fixture drill is explicitly not a customer migration.
